about: Cases for ci/video/sync_gate_selftest.py. Each renders a tiny synthetic mp4 with ffmpeg (two narrated beats, captions burned in the band) and lists the exact set of gate checks that must fail; an empty list must pass. composed_good goes through narrate.py (tone engine) and compose.py, so the composer and the gate are proven together. cap_seconds is this fixture's own copy of the cap; tests/test_video_beats.py checks it agrees with the gate and the workflows.
